integrity: The finite regular-CW collapse, cell enumeration, graph connectivity and dihedral character are reproducible using embedded standalone verifier and 280-pair certificate. No scientific assertion outside these documented checks is certified.
scientific_limitations: Exact ordinary graph-Hom complex for the explicitly specified standard Chvátal target and the five-cycle source only; no theorem for other codomains or source lengths; rational rather than integral dihedral isotypic decomposition. Priority subject to inaccessible/unindexed work; no independent validation.
title: The pentagon Hom complex of the Chvátal graph: sixty-one circles and a dihedral character
